description:
Make every caller of the gate-run record path constructor pass the run's issue, so the per-issue layout later changes only the constructor's body.

## Background

The semantic-types epic makes `VirtualPath::gate_run_record(&GateRunId)` the only builder of a run record path, replacing `gate_run_result_relative_path` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:512-520`) and its spellings at `storage/gate_runs.rs:34-38` and `commands/mod.rs:2863-2871`. Its callers are the finalizer's gate-run pass (`mutation.rs:1052-1095`), the evaluation and precheck new-run captures (`commands/gate_check.rs:860`, `commands/mod.rs:2863-2871`), the latest-run captures, both backends' loaders, the storage reference projection (`storage/reference.rs:462,797`), the tracker-written paths test (`gate_execution.rs:705,1127`) and the corrupt-run CLI test (`tests/cli_gate/gate_cli_integration_test.rs:169-200`). Every caller has the run's issue at hand.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath::gate_run_record` takes `(&IssueId, &GateRunId)`, and every caller passes the run's issue. The produced path is unchanged; the issue argument is `gate-run-flat-path-bridge`, an interim step whose removal is the per-issue layout.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The gate-run record path constructor takes the run's issue
